input_files: F3 SQLite source; canonical pair basis; contract field export
side_effect_policy: writes only to explicit output-dir; no DWH writes; source inputs read-only
determinism_policy: stable sort pair_i,pair_j; explicit numpy/scipy versions recorded or precision declared
randomness_policy: no randomness allowed in K reconstruction
expected_hash_or_similarity_rule: exact K sha256 e1acdf0acf31e2faf68f8a517cbdbccb2f9af9e28fe974eeb01c0a7f0928754d or reviewed similarity rule
dry_run_mode: checks inputs, schemas, row counts, policies, and would-write manifest without K computation
validation_mode: executes validation against existing or reconstructed K; reports finite/shape/symmetry/diagonal/PSD/rank/hash
failure_modes: missing input; hash mismatch; duplicate pair; missing pair; missing source row; nonfinite value; zero norm vector; policy missing; hidden state detected
